annotations.title: QE Virtual AI Machine: one liquidity machine per country, its money pipes and the exact repair of each one

description: The OwlChart QE Virtual AI Machine (v5.904), one machine per country. what=countries (the World board: every built country with its gauge from 0 to 100, its word DRYING, TURNING or FLOODING, how many of its wired pipes are flowing and the date of its latest report, plus the countries still being wired). With country=us (United States), gb (United Kingdom), jp (Japan), es (Spain), fr (France), cn (China) or ge (Georgia): what=now (the gauge, the word, the counts, two plain sentences, the latest and the next report), pipes (that country's own pipes in six fixed categories: central bank, government cash and debt, the price of money, inflation, households, global crypto and gold; each with its value, the date of the observation, a state, a reason, and the exact repair: who decides, the exact report with the publisher's page, the exact line in it and the number that turns it green with the gap from today), repairs (the leaking and slow pipes with their fix, target, next date and odds, soonest first), log (one line per report that changed a pipe), brief, history (one reading a day), country (the five layer country guide for es). No country holds another country's pipe; a pipe set abroad is marked, for example decided in Frankfurt. OwlChart does not create money or QE; central banks do. It takes no side and names no party or person. Data only, never a buy or sell instruction.
